Nora (PartnerOps): Heads-up from OEM marketplace: they're enabling bulk-retry for failed usage batches next Tuesday. Their note: retries will be emitted with new `batch_id` and `attempt` fields. Could impact our dedupe and entitlement mapping.
Diego (Integrations): Do they keep a stable `claim_id` inside each usage entry? If not, we'll see duplicates.
Nora (PartnerOps): Sample from vendor: ```json
{
  "batch_id": "b-20250611-1",
  "attempt": 2,
  "claims": [{"claim_id": null, "entitlement_id": "ent-123", "units": 100}]
}
``` They say older integrations relied on `batch_id` uniqueness.
Helena (Analytics): If claim_id is null we must infer id (danger). Suggest deriving a stable claim fingerprint: sha1(entitlement_id + customer_id + hour + units). Then dedupe on fingerprint.
Tom (Finance): Any chance retries change units (e.g., partial uploads) and not exact duplicates? We need to detect updated claims vs pure retries.
Diego (Integrations): Good point. Proposed algorithm: if claim_id is present, use it. If null, compute fingerprint and treat subsequent with same fingerprint + different units as an update (upsert), not a duplicate. If fingerprint matches and units equal -> drop duplicate.
marketplace-webhook-bot: delivery-note: vendor reported 10% of failed batches will be retried within 10 minutes, 1% after 1 hour.
Helena (Analytics): I'll add a recon job that emits `marketplace.retry.delta` per customer-hour: fields -> customer_id, hour, raw_claims, distinct_claims, updated_claims, dup_pct. Need schema signoff.
Tom (Finance): Make sure updated_claims show net delta in billable units. Finance needs a daily report for any customer with net delta > 0.2%. Also define credit policy for retro-active negatives.
Nora (PartnerOps): Action plan: 1) Diego implements fingerprint + upsert logic behind feature flag `marketplace_bulk_retry_v2`, 2) Helena builds hourly delta job and dashboard, 3) Tom to propose credit thresholds and escalation path, 4) Nora to ask vendor to include stable `claim_id` in follow-up.
Diego (Integrations): I'll open a small PR with pseudo: ```python
claim_id = claim.get('claim_id') or sha1(f"{claim['entitlement_id']}|{claim['customer_id']}|{claim['hour']}|{claim['units']}")
# upsert on (customer_id, hour, claim_id)
```
Helena (Analytics): I'll create a Looker tile and a scheduled job to output `marketplace_bulk_retry.{hour}.csv` to S3 for finance.
Tom (Finance): Please include original_batch_id and attempt in the report so we can trace back. Also require a 48h buffer before auto-credit to allow partner fixes.
Nora (PartnerOps): Vendor agreed to delay global flip 48h to let us shadow. ETA: staging patch + tests by EOD, shadow run tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Notifying the vendor.
Diego (Integrations): Will add metrics `marketplace.bulk_retry.fingerprint_mapped` and `marketplace.bulk_retry.upserts`.
Helena (Analytics): Will add alert if dup_pct > 1% for any customer-hour.
Tom (Finance): I'll join the shadow review. Schedule a short sync 05:45 UTC tomorrow.
Nora (PartnerOps): Thanks all — will post rollout checklist and PR links here.
